system.description:
Most people can drive, but you drive well. Equally at home with stick or automatic, you can wring the most from a car, evade traffic and even use your vehicle as a weapon — though a station wagon is not a semi. An unfamiliar vehicle may require a Mental Challenge to figure out where everything is.

Drive tests most often involve a Physical Challenge of your reflexes.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
